conviction_note: Nothing decisive and unpriced: the 月次 put H1 operating profit roughly on the company's own ¥2.9bn H1 plan, no analyst bar exists, the full-year guide and the ¥29 dividend are likely held, and the two negatives (Kumamoto quake loss, data breach) are a one-off below OP and an already-public event. The findings sum to +0.20 and the scaled number is +0.07 (p_up 51 on a 3.5% scale). The small gap is deliberate: findings this balanced do not justify a lean.
bar: Company H1 (Mar-Aug 2026) plan, set 2026-04-09 and unchanged at Q1: 営業収益 ¥79,000m, OP ¥2,900m, ordinary ¥2,900m, NP ¥1,900m (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=8203). Full year ¥157,000m / OP ¥4,850m / NP ¥3,100m, dividend ¥29 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260409/140120260408500264.pdf). No 四季報 or IFIS consensus found and no analyst coverage, so the bar is the company plan only and every size is capped small. print_vs_bar_pct is on H1 operating profit.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0%, prev 0.0%, change 0.0 (as of 2026-09-29, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). It is a real zero, so there is no short fuel. 信用倍率 113x (scraped, in baseline): margin longs heavily crowded, a leveraged-retail overhang that is the baseline's main lean component (-1.03). No options, so no skew. Run-up -5.18% over 20d and -3.38% over 5d; the stock has fallen from 779 to 713 since the 2026-09-04 August 月次 (-8.5%). priced_lean_pct -0.77.

findings.finding: H1 operating profit should land close to the ¥2,900m H1 plan. Q1 OP was ¥1,591m (54.9% of the H1 plan, against 44.2% and 38.1% at the same point in the two prior years), so Q2 needs only ¥1,309m (-16.6% YoY on ¥1,569m). Q2 all-store sales ran about 99.3% of last year (Jun 93.4 / Jul 103.2 / Aug 101.2) and the gross margin was +0.8pt in Q1. My estimate is Q2 OP of about ¥1,250-1,450m and H1 OP of about ¥2,850-3,050m, with revenue about 1% short of ¥79,000m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY27 (2026-07-09, OP +28.5%, record): +4.7% from the prior close to the next close. H1 FY26 (2025-10-09, H1 OP +25% with FY and dividend raised): -9.3% after a run to 875. Q4 (2026-04-09): -4.1%. Q3 (2026-01-09): -3.9%. Computed from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/8203.T?range=3y&interval=1d
findings.why_not_priced: The stock has fallen 8.5% since the August 月次 (2026-09-04, -3.3% the next day), so holders sold the Q2 decline. What nobody publishes is the arithmetic that the H1 plan already allowed for a Q2 OP fall of about 17%: there is no analyst coverage, so no estimate exists to show it. If the market had priced an in-plan H1, the stock would not have drifted down for a month on the 月次 alone. This is an inference from 月次 plus Q1, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Q1 tanshin and Q1 reference materials, a different document: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260709/140120260709590178.pdf (Q1 OP 1,591, gross margin +0.8pt). The H1 plan figures come from https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=8203

findings.finding: The Kumamoto earthquake of 2026-07-28 (shindo 7 in Uki City, where the Matsubase store is) damaged the Kumamoto Inter and Matsubase stores' ceilings and walls; both still trade on reduced floor space as of the September 月次, and the company has said for three months that the impact is 'under review'. A disaster special loss (災害による損失) at H1 is likely, which would put H1 NP below the ¥1,900m plan even with OP on plan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FY26: a ¥265m impairment cut FY NP guidance by ¥200m on 2026-03-27 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260327/140120260326589618.pdf). The FY print that followed moved -4.1%, with no clean attribution. Dividend policy excludes one-off losses, so a special loss does not reach the dividend.
findings.why_not_priced: No special-loss notice has been filed, so the size is unknown and not in any number. If it were priced, the company would have filed a 特別損失の計上 notice, which TDnet does not show (kabutan disclosure list checked to 2025-09). Because no notice was filed, the loss is probably below the materiality threshold, so it is sized at a fraction of the same money as OP and stays small.
findings.independence: Earthquake date and shindo 7 in Uki: https://kumanichi.com/articles/2018861 (snippet_only). The ongoing reduced trading is repeated in the September 月次: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20261005/140120261005546049.pdf

findings.finding: On 2026-10-06 the company disclosed unauthorized access to the MrMax app and online-store servers, leaking member ID, name, email and phone for up to 1,735,154 members, with the financial impact 'under review'. The H1 release is likely to carry a cautious note or a subsequent-event mention, which argues against any full-year raise.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior incident. On the disclosure day (2026-10-06, 11:00) the stock closed -0.6% on 297,800 shares, about 5x normal volume, then -0.1% on 10-07.
findings.why_not_priced: The breach itself is public and the stock absorbed it at -0.6%. What is unpriced is only whether the release quantifies costs or names the breach as a reason to hold the guide, which is a small add. Because the base fact is public, the finding is held near 0.
findings.independence: none (single primary document). The Japanese version is the same notice: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20261006/140120261006546323.pdf

findings.finding: September existing-store sales were 100.0% and customers 100.4%, both above last year for the first time in four months, helped by a liquor-tax pull-forward. This is the first month of H2, which must deliver about +18% OP YoY (¥1,950m against ¥1,638m) for the ¥4,850m full-year plan, so it makes a held full-year forecast at this print more credible than a cut.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The FY guide was raised at H1 last year (2025-10-09) and the stock fell 9.3% over the window, so a held guide is not obviously sold. The 月次 was published 2026-10-05 at 15:00 and the stock fell 0.3% the next session.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public, but the stock kept falling after it (723 to 713), so the market is not reading it as support for the guide. The incremental item is the company's hold or cut decision. Sized small because the September figure is flattered by the one-off liquor-tax pull-forward, which reverses in October.
findings.independence: The same document as finding 1 (the September 月次). The H2 arithmetic uses the Q1 reference materials https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260709/140120260709590178.pdf and the FY26 quarterly OP history at https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=8203

outside_window.finding: Corporate split of the 'おかしばっかし' confectionery chain into a new company, with 51% sold to 外林. The split takes effect 2026-12-01 and the share transfer completes in December 2026; a small profit or loss on the transfer is possible.
October 月次 will show the reversal of the September liquor-tax pull-forward, plus any sales loss from the app and online-store suspension after the breach.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: a hold of FY OP ¥4,850m and the ¥29 dividend is most likely (about 75%); a cut needs H2 +18% OP, a raise is unlikely with the breach under review. Returns: none expected beyond the held ¥29 year-end dividend; no buyback history. New-year guide: not applicable at H1. Quarter: Q1 progress was 54.9% of the H1 OP plan against 44.2% and 38.1% in the prior two years, and the Q2 月次 (all-store 99.3%) leave H1 near plan.
baseline_tension: The baseline leans -0.77, mostly on the 113x margin-long overhang, and the stock is down 5.2% over 20 days. My findings are near-balanced at +0.2. The strongest positive the release could carry is an H1 on plan with a held FY guide and dividend after a month of selling on public 月次 (悪材料出尽くし); I looked for a buyback, a 優待 change or a dividend raise and found no sign of any. The crowded margin long is the one setup in which even an in-line print still meets sellers, which is why p_up stays at 51.
lessons_applied: Rule 1: the breach finding rests on a fact already public on 2026-10-06 and absorbed by the price, so it moved from -0.3 to -0.2. The quake-loss finding stays at -0.3 because the release ADDS its size.
Rule 2: two negatives against two positives, so the sign is not tilted; the strongest positive (in-plan H1, held guide, 悪材料出尽くし) is written into baseline_tension. p_up unchanged at 51.
abs_move_pct, p_up and print_vs_bar_pct are unchanged.
